0022600003.text: Both the San Antonio Spurs and Oklahoma City Thunder open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, which is the Spurs' home opener, though San Antonio will be without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). Oklahoma City is missing Nikola Topic (back, surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee, surgery), and Cason Wallace is day-to-day with an undisclosed issue and is a game-time decision. The Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 4-1 and the 2025-26 playoffs series 4-3, most recently beating the Thunder 111-103 in Oklahoma City on May 30, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives San Antonio a 55% chance to win.
